item.title: Two Ghanaian UN peacekeepers critically injured in missile strike on Lebanon base
item.description: Two Ghanaian United Nations peacekeepers were critically injured after missiles struck their battalion’s headquarters in Lebanon on Friday, Ghana’s armed forces said in a statement. item.description: The State Department warned on Friday that Iran-aligned militias in Iraq may be targeting hotels used by foreigners in the Kurdistan region, as the US worked to evacuate thousands of Americans stranded across the Middle East. item.description: Iran has not closed the Strait of Hormuz but will not allow vessels linked to the United States or Israel to pass through it, a senior Iranian military spokesman told state television. item.description: The United States is on course to control Iranian airspace and expects to complete its objectives in the country within four to six weeks, White House press secretary Karoline Leavitt said on Friday. item.title: Hezbollah stockpiled weapons for months before entering war, sources say
item.description: Hezbollah spent months rebuilding its arsenal of rockets and drones before entering the regional war, drawing on a monthly budget of $50 million — most of it from Iran — and its own weapons manufacturing, six sources familiar with the group’s preparations told Reuters. item.title: UN Iran ambassador says 1,332 civilians killed since beginning of war
item.description: At least 1,332 Iranian civilians have been killed and thousands more injured in the conflict with Israel and the United States, Iran’s UN ambassador Amir Saeid Iravani said on Friday. Iravani made the remarks while speaking to reporters at the United Nations in New York. (Reuters)

item.title: Drone attack on foreign oil compound in Iraq’s Basra sets Halliburton and KBR facilities ablaze
item.description: Fires broke out at offices and warehouses belonging to US firms Halliburton and KBR after a drone attack targeted a compound housing foreign oil company employees in Iraq’s Basra, security sources told Reuters on Friday. (Reuters)

item.description: The United States is pressing Sri Lanka not to repatriate survivors from an Iranian warship it sank this week, or the crew of a second Iranian vessel in Sri Lankan custody, according to an internal State Department cable seen by Reuters.
